definitions.short: a Tirathite or inhabitant of an unknown Tirah
definitions.full: H8654. Tirathim תִּרְעָתִים proper name, masculine plural a Kenite family , 1Chr 2:55 ; Θαργαθυμ .
definitions.rootNote: patrial from an unused name meaning gate;

occurrences.englishText: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
